decisions.statement: A value that is no record is answered with the defaults.
Performance tracing is off unless the game asked for that tracing.
The bank script profiler is off unless the game asked for that profiler.
A profiler that is off is left out of the settings rather than written off.
A level the game wrote that is no known level falls back to the default.
Confirmation is asked for every destructive action by default.
A confirmation list that is no array is answered with the defaults.
An action named in the list that no longer exists is dropped.
An empty confirmation list is kept rather than read as unset.
Open cooldown protection is on unless the game wrote that setting false.
Nothing here reads or writes a file.

definition: how the logging and safety settings the game wrote are read into known values
